why: A PATCH (one swap): Stromkirk Noble out, Swords to Plowshares in. The Noble is a builder-filled slot (components castability 1.0, curve 1.0, similarity 0.78, synergy 0.33, EDHREC 0.08, combo 0; alternates within 0.004) with no relation to the draw/discard engine — the pilot's own read, 2026-10-01: 'what is the point of this in the deck?'. The deck answers NO resolved permanent of any class (audit interaction-breadth: 0 of 5 classes; interaction 7/8 UNDER, counted mostly as pingers) and lost 53 of 105 decided games to sythis-enchantress, a creature-based engine, in its latest 120-game run at standard-v3 (rate 0.124). Swords is the one-mana answer to Sythis herself; recon finding 2 names it at 63% of partner lists. The objective is the real table: does answering the dominant seat move the rate — MDE at 200/arm against 0.124 is about 0.11, so the line sits at 0.20. Every add is cast-checked before the arm (the 2026-10-01 gate).
